synthesis:draft.headline: Largest absolute POE50 forecast error in the VIC1 target window was -508.0 MW for interval ending 2026-07-28 16:30 AEST (UTC+1000).
summary: MAE for VIC1 POE50 forecasts over the target window = 186.88 MW (ev0653).

possible_explanations.statement: Observed temperatures at 2026-07-28T04:00:00Z and 2026-07-28T15:00:00Z (observed T2M samples) may have differed from the temperatures used by the forecast model, producing forecast errors.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the pre-dispatch forecasted T2M values used by the demand model to the observed T2M at 2026-07-28T04:00:00Z (ev0661) and 2026-07-28T15:00:00Z (ev0672).

possible_explanations.statement: AEMO's non-conformance notice for TRGBESS1 [c1] might be related to deviations between forecast and actual demand.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review the unit availability and constraint timeline for TRGBESS1 alongside the forecast/actual pairs and dispatch records for the same target window, and check notices and unit telemetry corresponding to [c1].

possible_explanations.statement: Short lead-time updates to public forecasts might have missed rapid changes in the region that the later runs captured, which could explain some of the interval errors.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare forecast errors for the same targets issued at different lead times (earlier vs later runs) against the same actuals to see whether error magnitude systematically declines with shorter lead time.
